home.whoWeAreBody: Ajilchin Zögii is a non-governmental organisation protecting the labour rights of working children and teenagers through collective bargaining, negotiation and policy work. We publish evidence rather than promotion: every figure here can be traced back to how it was counted.
home.pillarsLead: Three sides of it: how we measure, what we found, and what we are trying to change.
home.collaborateBody: We welcome researchers, organisations, funders and journalists. Our data and our methods are published, so they can be checked, repeated and argued with.

pillarBody.methodology: For every figure we publish the definition behind it, how many cases it rests on, and the date it was true. The fewer-than-five rule: a figure based on fewer than five cases is never shown as a number, because small numbers can identify a person.
pillarBody.research: Reports are published with their data and their code. Citations are ready in APA and BibTeX, so using the work does not mean retyping it.
pillarBody.policy: Submissions and legislative changes are laid out in order, with dates and sources — separating what was proposed from what was actually adopted.
